verdict_notes: Sol found and fixed all 6 planted bugs (14/14). Opus was 2.7x faster (69.7s) but missed one: merge_busy still uses 's >= cur_end' so touching intervals like (60,120)+(120,180) don't merge, despite the docstring example spelling it out. Correctness beats speed - Sol takes the round.
